verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog's docs say it automatically tracks lineage as data and AI assets are used and logs activity for auditing, and Delta table history can be used to audit operations. However, the evidence never explicitly documents column-level lineage or the who-ran-what detail of the audit logs. missing for 10: explicit column-level lineage documentation, detail on audit log contents (user identity, actions, query text) and how to access them, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I get audit logs of who ran what and column-level lineage of where data came from
